title: fix(plugin-grid): title the phone-width card by the declared nameField, not the first column (objectui#13150)
body:
Fixes #13150
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

On phone-width screens, `ObjectGrid` draws each record as a stacked card. The card branch took the first displayed column as the card title (`const titleCol = displayColumns[0]; // First column is always the title`). A view whose first column was Owner, a lookup, titled every card "Dev Admin", and the record's own name ("Plant A check") sat in a body row at the bottom of the card.

The card is now titled by the object's declared `nameField`:

- **Read through `declaredNameField`.** This is the resolver's single spelling of the pointer, and the same one the bulk confirm step names records by (objectui#13107). `ObjectGrid` already imports it and already holds the object definition (`objectSchema`, the same value it hands `BulkActionDialog` as `objectDef`). No second way to find the name field is added, and nothing guesses a field by its name.
- **The name field is a shown column:** that column titles the card. The card body is every other shown column, so the name is not shown twice, and the first column it displaced (Owner) reads as an ordinary body row.
- **The name field is not a shown column:** the title reads the row's value of it. Measured first: both fetches that feed this grid already ask for the declared `nameField` whether or not a column shows it (`ObjectGrid`'s `getSelectFields`, objectui#13107, and `ListView`'s `$select` harvest, objectui#13116). A masked name field with no column has no `cell`, so the title draws `MaskedCellRenderer` for it, which keeps the fail-closed rule.
- **The row has no value for the declared name field** (for example, the viewer may not read it, so it is not fetched): the title shows the card's existing empty marker (an em dash). No other field stands in for the declared name.
- **The object declares no `nameField`:** the first shown column stays the title, and the body is unchanged.

The card's title element now carries `data-testid="grid-card-title"`. That is the selector for the browser reading at 390x844. Before this change the title was an untagged `div.font-semibold.text-sm.truncate.mb-1`, and its classes are unchanged.

Nothing is added to the package entry: no export, prop, schema key or type member. The grid's empty state in the same file is untouched (objectui#13142 is not addressed here).

## Pins

New file `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/mobileCardTitleNameField-13150.test.tsx`. It drives the real `ObjectGrid` at `innerWidth` 390. The data source honours `$select` the way a server does: a row carries the selected keys only.

- The measured shape: columns Owner (lookup), Notes, Name, with `nameField: 'name'`. Each card is titled by its name, its body shows "Dev Admin", and the name does not appear again in the body.
- `nameField` not a column (columns Owner, Notes): the cards are still titled by the name, and the last `find` call's `$select` carries `name`.
- The server leaves `name` off every row: both titles read as an em dash, never "Dev Admin".
- CONTROL: an object that declares no `nameField` keeps Owner ("Dev Admin") as the title, with the name in the body.

## Ablations (one-off, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in the objectstack checkout; no permanent test)

The test imports `../ObjectGrid` from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run. Each mutation landed on disk (anchor count 1 to 0). Each was restored and checked: the blob equals the HEAD blob `790065a2608d` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

1. Title back to the first column (`titleCol = displayColumns[0]`): blob `790065a2608d` became `21f43c2a79d8`. 3 of 4 went red, each receiving `[ 'Dev Admin', 'Dev Admin' ]`. That is the card's symptom, reproduced. The control stayed green.
2. Body no longer drops the title column (`bodyColumns = displayColumns`): blob `790065a2608d` became `cc455adef36f`. The measured-shape pin went red (`expected 'OwnerDev AdminNotesBoiler roomNamePla…' not to contain 'check'`); the other 3 stayed green.

## Gates (head `17838dd`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the new file: 4/4 passed.
- Every `plugin-grid` test that sets `innerWidth` (the tests that reach the card branch), plus `bulkConfirmNameField-13107.test.tsx`: 18 files, 98 tests passed.
- Every `app-shell` test that sets `innerWidth`: 26 files, 129 tests passed.
- The full `packages/plugin-grid/` directory and `pnpm lint` are left to CI.
- Dependency closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. The new test is in the test program (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. It found 1 changeset for 1 released package.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `eslint` on the two changed source and test files: 0 errors. The warnings are `no-explicit-any` in the test file, in the same style as the sibling `mobileCardLookupDisplay` test.
- No i18n keys and no README or `content/docs` fences were touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **The displaced first column keeps its desktop cell face in the body.** `generateColumns` makes column one the record link (`primary-field-link`). When the name field takes the title, that column moves into the card body and is drawn through its own `cell`, so its value is styled as a link. The link opens the same record that tapping the card opens, and it stops the event from reaching the card's own click handler. A lookup column elsewhere in the body is already drawn as a link, to the referenced record. This is noted only. It needs a card-only face from the column builder, which is outside this claim's file surface.
- **A viewer who may not read the name field** now sees an em dash as every card's title, where before the title was the first column's value. This is the "never another field" rule the bulk confirm step follows, and the body still shows the other columns.
- No README or guide text describes how the card picks its title, so no docs changed.
- `changeset`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.
